verdict.rationale: Supabase ships an AI Assistant inside the Dashboard that offers context-aware support for database management (supabase-docs-41, supabase-docs-19), so in-product AI suggestions exist. However, the evidence is only marketing-level and never shows the assistant producing insights from the user's actual data. Advisors only return deterministic findings, not AI ones (supabase-docs-16), and MCP access runs through external agents rather than inside the product. missing for 10: explicit documentation of AI-generated insights or analysis over the user's data, detail on what suggestions the assistant gives, independent or hands-on corroboration.
